svg.title: E41 Ellipse null: mean IoU per fire
svg.desc: Small multiples, one bar chart per fire, of mean IoU for persistence, the Circle, the three pre-registered Ellipse variants (ERA5, station, ERA5 wind x3) and a post-hoc centred-ellipse control (dashed outline), with the Circle's E33 ±1 sd band so a real gain or loss over the Circle can be told from noise.
svg.text: MEAN IOU OVER THE OBSERVATION SERIES, PER FIRE
